source_records.body: Fictional local record for Clover puzzle booklet. The first preview contains the requested booklet sequence. This record covers a local preview only.

For Clover, you can distribute the booklet only after Zuri accepts the key. For Clover, permission to distribute the booklet also requires that the proof log records a large-print reading. Both conditions for permission to distribute the booklet in Clover are necessary because a normal-size proof cannot test the enlarged key.

In Clover, the puzzle prize list is independent of the Clover puzzle booklet. For Clover puzzle prize list, reserve one prize for the junior group. I want the Clover puzzle prize list kept in planning until its own review.

For Clover, open the puzzle booklet work item. For Clover puzzle booklet, retain the clue identifiers because the answer sheet refers to them. At this opening meeting, Clover puzzle booklet is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Clover puzzle booklet sets grid size to 9 squares. The large-print page is a separate follow-up to Clover puzzle booklet.
I will put the Clover puzzle booklet preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 16.
For the next step on Clover puzzle booklet, keep large-print copies in proof status. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
I believe distribution for Clover puzzle booklet is complete because the local preview finished.
Fictional status record for Clover puzzle prize list. Clover puzzle prize list remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
Correction for Clover puzzle booklet: use grid size of 12 squares, replacing my initial value of 9 squares. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Clover puzzle booklet.

I accept the booklet sequence for Clover puzzle booklet. I close Clover puzzle booklet. While closing Clover puzzle booklet, I do not accept the Clover large-print page. At this review, cancel the Clover large-print page. There is no time for the large-print page in this review window.
This chat continues the same Clover puzzle booklet work item opened in the first chat. The Clover puzzle booklet constraint to retain the clue identifiers still applies.

Fictional execution receipt for Clover puzzle booklet. The recorded command created a local booklet proof for Clover puzzle booklet. The recorded command did not perform distribution for Clover puzzle booklet. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

Reopen the Clover large-print page because the first key was illegible in large print. The Clover large-print page must add the high-contrast solution key. The accepted Clover puzzle booklet stays closed while the large-print page is open.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
